contracts.eligible-prose-wrap: Replace one ASCII word separator in the authored eligible prose fixtures with a newline. Excludes code spans, escapes, hard breaks, structural line starts and destination bytes. Compare projected block content.
contracts.closed-block-append: Append a tested block after an explicit heading boundary. Compare the original projected blocks, excluding document-level section growth and generated IDs.
contracts.reference-classification: Add or replace a matching reference definition. Compare the first paragraph with resolved destinations and titles omitted. Carve and Djot preserve reference syntax; CommonMark matching definitions can change text into links.
contracts.nonreference-control: Inline links and code spans contain no reference to resolve; adding or replacing a reference definition must leave their projected first paragraph unchanged.
contracts.nested-container-payload: Wrap a fragment in one-item lists and quotes with authored indentation, then remove exactly those wrappers. Compare the projected payload; this does not claim arbitrary definition scoping.
